description: This file defines the implementation details of KernelFunction class in PyTorch's ATen library, including constructors, methods for calling kernels, token management, and factory functions for creating KernelFunction instances.

classes.name: KernelFunction
classes.description: Represents a kernel function in PyTorch, supporting boxed and unboxed invocation, token registration, and factory methods.

classes.name: KernelToken
classes.description: Manages validity state of kernel tokens for safe kernel invalidation.

classes.name: SafeKernelFunction
classes.description: Wraps KernelFunction with safety checks and token management for thread-safe kernel invocation.
